item.title: Closing time? Blackhawk Plaza faces foreclosure amid increasing vacancies
item.description: Blackhawk Plaza could find itself in new hands once again, with a court hearing in southern California later this month on a request to put the property into receivership status as a lender seeks to go after a $5 million loan they say that the property owners have defaulted on.
